## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior. Is this OCR recognition, text placement,
verification, installation, or resume behavior?

## Reproduction

Command, commit, Python version, OS, and (if relevant) GPU and container image tags.
Use a small synthetic or redistributable input. Do not attach copyrighted scans,
private OCR text, review files, databases, credentials, or unredacted logs.

## Evidence

Include the relevant sanitized error and report fields. Describe whether the
original pixels, extracted characters, coordinates, or reading order changed.
